wrap_model_in_ddp: wrap a PyTorch model in DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training when distributed is active
sync_model_gradients_and_buffers: synchronize model gradients and buffers across all workers after backward pass as a DDP alternative
average_metrics_across_workers: average a dictionary of metrics across all distributed workers using all-reduce with optional weighting
create_distributed_dataloader: create a DataLoader with DistributedSampler for training or manual sharding for evaluation in distributed mode
broadcast_object_to_workers: broadcast a picklable Python object from one worker to all other workers in a distributed setting
